question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete

the letter series.

_ X _ F _ _ _ X T _ X _
solution:
Given series: _ X _ F _ _ _ X T _ X _

Option 1) FXXTFXT → __F__ X __X__ F __X__ __T__ __F__ X T __X__ X __T__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)
